service.description: From a value of a saved panel to its meaning, a breakdown and the records behind it, for an Insights reader (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED otherwise). The request names the definition, the panel, one of its queries, the range and the buckets chosen as the panel showed them (selectedBuckets of field and value, or the same list as JSON text, bucketsJson); the report engine's get#Drill reads the saved panel as the viewer and computes every predicate, so no query, entity or service is taken from the request, and the organization in scope is fixed over any variable sent (a requested organization only when it is the user's). Answers the measure's registered meaning, the panel's buckets, a breakdown by one of the dataset's dimensions (or the engine's refusal of it), and a page of records with the query's own columns and each record's Insights record screen. A viewer who reads the totals and not the records gets rowsAvailable false and no record; a panel, definition or dataset the viewer may not read answers available false with a reason that does not say whether it exists.

parameter.name: answerRefusal
parameter.description: For a screen (impl-admin F129): a refusal is answered as refusalCode and refusal instead of failing the call

parameter.name: drill
parameter.description: reason, title, definitionType, datasetId, range, organizationPartyId, meaning, selected, dimensions, panelBuckets, breakdownDimension, breakdownRefused, breakdown, rowsAvailable, rowsReason, columns, rows, total, bounded, pageIndex, pageMaxIndex, and the parameters of its links (carry, clear, previous, next)

parameter.name: refusalCode
parameter.description: With answerRefusal: the refusal's code, or FAILED

parameter.name: refusal
parameter.description: With answerRefusal: why it was refused, safe to show

service.description: The record behind a report's value, read only, for an Insights reader (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED otherwise): what the admitted datasets the viewer reads say of it (each read through the report engine as the viewer, so its admission and row filter decide; named columns only, never a cost), the owning apps' screens of it that open to the viewer by the owner's own authorization, and the return to the report (the drill's parameters). recordType is the shared record screen (OrderDetail, Customer360, Supplier360, Product360, RequestDetail, WorkItemDetail, ShipmentDetail, FacilityDetail, EquipmentDetail, InvoiceDetail). A record no source shows the viewer answers recordFound false, whether or not it exists, with no owner link.

parameter.name: record
parameter.description: recordFound, recordLabel, recordId, sources (title, total, bounded, failed, rows of title and text), owners (label, url), hasReturn, returnParameters

service.description: Whether the caller's own grants open Commons (opens): what the Insights root asks before it serves its Chatter or RecordFiles mount (the record panels of design-drawers-commons, mounted under every app root) or any transition of theirs, since the Insights root's inheritable grant would otherwise open their writes to a user given Insights without Commons. Such a user reaches the same panels in Commons under the same filters. False for a caller without Insights read.
